decision: Calendar, Checklist, Todo, Sheet, and Memo are projections of effective Item data and never canonical storage alternatives.

artifactSelectionPriority.when: The job fails without real date/time control.
The retained control surface is one bounded set of independent completions.
The retained control surface is an open or reorderable next-action/resource queue.
Stable rows, Fields, comparisons, progress, or records are central.
Retained guidance, context, recipe detail, or source explanation completes the job.

primary.rule: Choose the one artifact whose loss would make the user job fail.

secondary.rule: Add only when it provides distinct utility and does not duplicate the primary artifact.

forbiddenProjection.rule: Record a reason when a plausible-looking destination would invent schedule, flatten required state, expose private/review data, or misrepresent the source.

selectionInvariants: The selected primary projection contains at least one entry, row, or block.
When calendar.selected is false, calendar.eventCount and calendar.entries are both zero; eligibleScheduledItemCount may still describe a future selectable Calendar path.
A primary Calendar requires at least one scheduled Item and one VEVENT projection entry.
A structure_only_no_items template may select Sheet or Memo only when SourceRows map to Field or Memo entities; it never receives a synthetic Item or Calendar event.

targets.canonicalEligibility: Item has an effective supported schedule, or a Step bundle contains only Items with one equal effective schedule.
descriptionCarries: action detail needed at execution time

targets.canonicalEligibility: Item has check or decision completion and remains meaningful as a bounded set.
minimumFields: detail or source link when needed
loss: skip and hold may degrade to labels
typed decision or record values may need a link back or Sheet fallback

targets.canonicalEligibility: Item is a next action, decision, or resource use that can stand alone in a queue.
minimumFields: optional due date only when scheduled
loss: record Fields require Sheet or FlowMe fallback

targets.canonicalEligibility: Stable source rows, Item or occurrence state, comparison columns, or record Fields exist.
minimumFields: source link or SourceRow IDs according to export policy
loss: complex dependency or condition behavior unless exported as columns

targets.canonicalEligibility: Any Flow may use Memo as a loss-aware fallback; it is primary when retained context is the natural artifact.
minimumFields: cautions that belong to user execution

none.chooseWhen: No effective supported schedule exists or Calendar would not help the user job.
none.hardRule: Undated Items produce zero VEVENT components.

per_item.chooseWhen: Default for scheduled Items and whenever child completion, time, location, or meaning differs.
per_item.component: one sibling VEVENT per scheduled Item or recurrence master/instance according to request policy
per_item.identity: stable Item ID plus occurrence identity

chooseWhenAll: two or more child Items share one exact effective schedule
the child Items form one user moment
the event description contains all child Item IDs and labels
rejectWhenAny: one child needs separate decision or record state in the destination
one child has a different location/timezone
the compact event would obscure a source-required action
the destination is expected to round-trip child completion
step_bundle.component: one VEVENT with childItemIds metadata/description; never nested VEVENT or VTODO

components.VEVENT: Scheduled occurrence or qualified Step bundle.
components.VTODO: Optional task projection only after destination capability confirmation.
components.VALARM: May be nested in VEVENT or VTODO when a reminder is explicitly requested.
components.VJOURNAL: Not used as a Flow, Step, or Map representation.

nestingRules: VEVENT and VTODO are siblings inside VCALENDAR.
Flow, Step, Bundle, and Map are never serialized as parent components.

uidInput: itemId or deterministic Step bundle key

relations.relatedTo: Optional capability; canonical hierarchy never depends on its preservation.
relations.xProperties: Optional implementation detail; canonical provenance and state never depend on their round trip.

projectionResult.recordIdentity: Every record carries Item ID, child Item IDs, or a Flow/Step document scope.
mustNotInclude: private values not selected by the user

lostPropertyShape.reason: Why the destination cannot represent it.
lostPropertyShape.fallback: Target or FlowMe surface that retains the value.

hardFailures: scheduled data invented for an undated Item
child Item IDs missing from a Step bundle
projection presented as completion owner when it cannot round-trip state

projectionProfiles.exception: step_bundle only for equal schedule and one user moment
calendar only after a supported source/user schedule exists
calendar only for a real revisit/deadline date
scheduled imported resources may use per-item Calendar
one real application Item may be scheduled by user overlay

validationRules: Primary and secondary artifacts do not overlap.
Calendar records reference only scheduled effective Items.
Every scheduled calendar record has stable Item/occurrence identity.
Every Step bundle retains child Item IDs and declares completion loss.
Every non-Calendar primary artifact remains usable without ICS.
Every projection has a loss manifest, even when severity is none.
VTODO support is not described as verified.
Review and promotion sidecars do not enter user projection.
